## Compile fixes at the pin (the whole diff from the handoff bytes)

Every theorem and lemma statement is byte-identical before `:=`; the 21 + 20 theorem names and the 11 + 6 definition names keep their order (41 theorems, 17 definitions; `SOURCE_FILES.json` lists them); no `sorry`, `axiom`, `native_decide` or `set_option` added.

`TorusTopology.lean`:
- `def torus_periodBasis`: type `Basis (Fin d) ℝ (torus_E d)` -> `Module.Basis (Fin d) ℝ (torus_E d)` (the structure is `Module.Basis` at this Mathlib; bare `Basis` was an unknown identifier that `autoImplicit` turned into a variable, the root of the first-run cascade; body unchanged).
- `theorem torus_basis_sum_eq_latticeVec`, proof: `Basis.unitsSMul_apply` -> `Module.Basis.unitsSMul_apply` in both `simp` calls; three unused simp arguments removed (`PiLp.single_apply` twice, `hij`) so the file elaborates with warnings as errors.
- `theorem torus_proj_isCoveringMap`, proof term: discreteness witness `DiscreteTopology.isDiscrete` -> `SetLike.isDiscrete_iff_discreteTopology.mpr (torus_lattice_addSubgroup_discrete d L hL)`, passed to the same lemma `AddSubgroup.isAddQuotientCoveringMap_of_comm`.
- `theorem torus_pathConnectedSpace`, proof: `infer_instance` -> `exact inferInstanceAs <| PathConnectedSpace (Quotient _)`.
- Module docstring: two lines recording the above; `namespace ResearchFormalCoreR1` -> `namespace TorusFiltration`.

`ClosedSuperlevel.lean`:
- `def superlevel_componentMap`: the second argument of `ZerothHomotopy.lift` has strict-implicit binders (`∀ ⦃x y⦄, Path x y → f x = f y`), which `fun p => …` did not introduce, so `p` was bound to a point; fixed to `fun _ _ p => ZerothHomotopy.sound (p.map f.continuous)`; the defined map is the same.
- Module docstring: three lines recording the above; `namespace ResearchFormalCoreR1` -> `namespace TorusFiltration`.
